questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow merging traffic to safely join your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the highway. You can change lanes to continue through, or you must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for pedestrians and vehicles to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm extended straight out signals a left turn or lane change to the left. Use hand signals when turn signals are not available.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully and reduce speed when the pavement is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians cross the road ahead. Be alert and slow down to allow pedestrians to cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided stop sign means you must stop and give the right-of-way. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you are entering a one-way street going the wrong way and risk a head-on crash. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided stop sign requires a complete stop. Look for pedestrians and cross traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming stop sign. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower if conditions are not ideal, such as bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road, slow down, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits passing. Do not try to pass another vehicle where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves ahead. Slow down and be prepared to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards and road conditions. This sign warns that there is low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane. You need to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights display colors from bottom to top in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make room for entering traffic. If the lane next to you is clear, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown, which is 35 mph in this case.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers turning left that they do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger, it signals the group to form a single-file line. Hand signals are important for communication while riding in groups.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that workers are on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this work zone.
